第一卷 第651章 知道我老师是怎么评价你的吗（第1页）
林芜知道，不管怎么样，都不能让事情继续发酵下去了。
她笑了下，第一时间开口，“郁总，我——”
然而，她开口时，连凝绮也开口了：“难道不是吗？”
连凝绮双手抱胸，不屑地看着郁默勋和容辞，说话的语气也没叶秋雨这么客气，“郁总，你既然敢做，怎么还不敢认了呢？郁总你要是敢承认，我还当你——”
林芜没想到连凝绮会忽然开口，脸色一变，忙开口：“小绮！”
打断连凝绮后，林芜看着郁默勋，正想开口，但郁默勋怎么可能会给她机会？
他看着连凝绮，似笑非笑，“连小姐是吗？如果我没记错，连小姐跟林小姐是非常要好的朋友呢，也难怪前段时间连小姐刚回国，就气势冲冲地杀到我们长墨来羞辱戏弄我们小辞一顿来给林小姐出气。”
“连小姐和林小姐感情还真是要好呢。”
说完，他也没给连凝绮开口的机会，就将视线转到了林芜身上，“林小姐，他们一个是你师兄，一个是你最要好的朋友，他们都愤愤不平地要替你讨回公道，想来，你无缘成为我师妹，肯定是你没少跟他们抱怨这件事吧？”
林芜知道，刚才在连凝绮开口时，这件事就很难再挽回了。
但她当然不会坐以待毙，开口道：“没有，郁总——”
他笑道：“我老师平时很少跟他的学生交流，关于我老师的很多事情，我很多都不太清楚。不过很巧的是，关于林小姐想要成为我师妹的事，我恰巧知道一些。林小姐想知道我老师是怎么评价你的吗？”
这在连凝绮和叶秋雨看来，郁默勋这就是妥妥地在欺负林芜。
他们正想开口，但他们开口前，郁默勋就已经提前开口了，他看着林芜，笑着说道：“我老师说您够不上成为他学生的标准，你……太平庸啦~”
林芜脸色骤白，身子差点没站稳，但她努力稳住了，她还是想维持着体面，挤出一抹笑：“郁总，我知道我资质平庸，所以，我——”
看到这里，台上的叶秋雨终于对郁默勋冷了脸色，“你别欺人太甚！”
郁默勋笑，看着叶秋雨：“我只是在说实话。”

他是真的没想到，郁默勋居然会无所顾忌地当着这么多人的面羞辱林芜。
林芜胸口剧烈地起伏着，看着这一幕，脸上一片惨白，她看向叶秋雨的眼神也非常冷。
叶秋雨没有注意到他眼底的冷意，但能看得出她脸色不好看，也看出她在强装镇定。
他以为她是被郁默勋的颠倒黑白给气着了，他越发心疼，但他也注意到了一旁的封庭深从头到尾都没有为林芜开过口，就这么任由郁默勋欺负他。
叶秋雨眼底的愤怒越来越浓，笑了。
他哈哈大笑，看着郁默勋，“郁默勋，你为了袒护这个女人，还真是一次次的让我大开眼界啊！”

Volume 1 Chapter 651 Do you know what my teacher said about you (Page 1)
Lin Wu knew that no matter what, he could not let things continue to ferment.
She smiled and spoke immediately, "Mr. Yu, I——"
However, when she spoke, even Ningqi also spoke: "Isn't it?"
Lian Ningqi crossed her arms and looked at Yu Moxun and Rong Ci with disdain. Her tone of voice was not as polite as Ye Qiuyu's, "Mr. Yu, since you dare to do it, why don't you dare to admit it? Mr. Yu, if you dare to admit it, I will treat you as——"
Lin Wu didn't expect Lian Ningqi to speak suddenly. His expression changed and he hurriedly said: "Xiao Qi!"
After interrupting Lian Ningqi, Lin Wu looked at Yu Moxun and was about to speak, but how could Yu Moxun give her a chance?
He looked at Lian Ningqi, half-smiling, "Miss Lian, right? If I remember correctly, Miss Lian and Miss Lin are very good friends. It's no wonder that Miss Lian just returned to China some time ago, and she rushed to our Chang Mo Lai to humiliate and tease us, just to vent her anger on Miss Lin."
"Miss Lian and Miss Lin are really close to each other."
After saying that, he didn't give Lian Ningqi a chance to speak, and turned his attention to Lin Wu, "Miss Lin, one of them is your senior brother, and the other is your best friend. They are both angrily trying to seek justice for you. Come to think of it, you have no chance to become my junior sister. You must have complained to them about this matter, right?"
Lin Wu knew that when Lian Ningqi opened her mouth just now, it would be difficult to undo this matter.
But of course she wouldn't sit still and said, "No, Mr. Yu——"
He smiled and said: "My teacher rarely communicates with his students. I don't know many things about my teacher. But coincidentally, I happen to know a little about Miss Lin's desire to become my junior sister. Miss Lin, do you want to know what my teacher thinks of you?"
In the eyes of Lian Ningqi and Ye Qiuyu, Yu Moxun was bullying Lin Wu.
They were about to speak, but before they spoke, Yu Moxun had already spoken in advance. He looked at Lin Wu and said with a smile: "My teacher said that you are not up to the standard of becoming his student. You... are too mediocre~"
Lin Wu's face suddenly turned pale and she almost lost her balance, but she tried her best to stabilize herself. She still wanted to maintain her dignity and forced a smile: "Mr. Yu, I know that my qualifications are mediocre, so, I -"
Seeing this, Ye Qiuyu on the stage finally turned cold to Yu Moxun, "Don't bully others too much!"
Yu Moxun smiled and looked at Ye Qiuyu: "I'm just telling the truth."
He really didn't expect that Yu Moxun would humiliate Lin Wu in front of so many people without any scruples.
Lin Wu's chest heaved violently. Looking at this scene, her face turned pale, and her eyes looking at Ye Qiuyu were also very cold.
Ye Qiuyu didn't notice the coldness in his eyes, but he could see that her face was not pretty, and that she was pretending to be calm.
He thought she was angry at Yu Moxun's confusion of right and wrong, and he felt more and more distressed, but he also noticed that Feng Tingshen beside him never spoke up for Lin Wu from beginning to end, and just allowed Yu Moxun to bully him.
The anger in Ye Qiuyu's eyes grew stronger and stronger, and he smiled.
He laughed loudly and looked at Yu Moxun, "Yu Moxun, in order to protect this woman, you really opened my eyes again and again!"
